figurative_meaning_en: Finding ways to earn a livelihood
example_sentences_in_bangla: সে গ্রামে ফিরে এসে করে খাওয়া করে চলেছে।
অর্থনৈতিক সংকটে অনেকেই করে খাওয়ার চেষ্টা করেন।
example_sentences_in_english: He returned to the village and is now finding ways to make a living.
During the economic crisis, many people try to earn a livelihood by any means.
note: This idiom reflects the resilience in Bengali society for self-reliance.
